audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN 4/10 with Gwen winning six of seven rows, against a 48.1% win rate and prose that says 'he wins it' early and 'a two-item Trundle reclaims the extended duel'.
audit.corrected: HARD 6/10 and the chart realigned in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and Subjugate was treated as the matchup cooldown.
audit.why: Gwen's only spike is Level 6 into Riftmaker; Trundle's are Frozen Domain and Pillar of Ice coming online and then Subjugate at two items.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice (15-21s) and Frozen Domain (14-18s) are now the tracked windows, with Subjugate as the late-game reason not to extend.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Chomp heals him ('his Q Chomp both steals your AD and heals him', 'Chomp self-heal', 'Chomp lifesteal') and treats the AD sap as decisive. Neither is right, and Pillar of Ice's terrain interaction is absent.
audit.why: Riot on Chomp: 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage' — no heal, and the sapped stat is attack damage, which an AP Gwen barely uses. His healing is King's Tribute: 'When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health', amplified by Frozen Domain, which grants 'increased healing from all sources while on it'. Riot on Pillar of Ice: it 'becom[es] impassable terrain' — and Gwen's own kit file describes Skip 'n Slash as 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny', so the pillar can block her dash outright.
audit.corrected: Heal reattributed to King's Tribute and Frozen Domain; the AD sap downgraded; Pillar of Ice's terrain block written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Subjugate (80-120s) was tracked; it is not the lane cooldown.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s and Frozen Domain 18/17/16/15/14s are the two that decide whether a trade is takeable; Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset and cannot be played around.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Trundle contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset that saps AD — near-irrelevant to an AP Gwen — but King's Tribute heals him off every minion that dies nearby.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Trundle's Subjugate is down.
edits.after: Frozen Domain gives him attack speed, move speed and increased healing. Never trade on his carpet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Trundle must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain — it can block Skip 'n Slash outright, so never dash at a Trundle holding E.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Subjugate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his window: Pillar is 15-21s and Frozen Domain 14-18s. Step up only when both are down, and never onto the carpet.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Trundle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your one window: drop Hallowed Mist as his Pillar lands so he cannot target you, then snip the fat bar with %-max-HP and true damage.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Subjugate's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker plus anti-heal — his sustain is King's Tribute, so Grievous Wounds bites.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Trundle carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Subjugate strips your armour and MR and doubles it over 4s while healing him — never take a long fight with his R up.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Snip him before/after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Pillar of Ice (15-21s): impassable terrain that can block Skip 'n Slash. - Frozen Domain (14-18s): boosts all his healing, so fight off the carpet. - Subjugate (80-120s): steals your resists. - Needlework: kill windows.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Trundle with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Trundle wastes Subjugate — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Trundle with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Pillar of Ice is spent — nothing can wall your dash for 15-21s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: fighting on Frozen Domain, where every heal he takes is increased and Chomp resets his autos.

edits.after: Snip his HP, but never on the Frozen Domain carpet — Pillar of Ice walls your dash, and King's Tribute, not Chomp, is the heal you have to anti-heal.

edits.after: Farm on Frozen Domain so King's Tribute heals amplified off every dying minion, winning the level 1-5 attrition Gwen can't sustain

edits.before: Drop the "Gwen beats tanks" instinct here — Trundle is a drain-tank, not a static one, so his Q Chomp steals your AD AND heals him every trade, which flips the trade math against you, and his W zone gives him the move speed to stay on top of you. With no mist and no real burst yet, don't contest the level 1-3 stat-check; he wins it. Last-hit from max Q range, dodge the Pillar (E) he drops to slow and chase, and accept you're behind on attrition until 6.
edits.after: Drop the "Gwen beats tanks" instinct here — Trundle is a drain-tank, not a static one. His sustain is King's Tribute, healing off every unit that dies near him and amplified while he stands on Frozen Domain (W); Chomp (Q) resets his auto every 3.5s and the AD it saps costs an AP Gwen almost nothing. With no mist and no burst, don't contest the level 1-3 stat-check. Last-hit at max Q range and never dash at a Trundle holding Pillar of Ice (E).

notes: The page credited Chomp with a heal it does not have and built the early-game advice around an AD sap that barely touches an AP Gwen. Riot's text puts the sustain on King's Tribute (units dying near him) amplified by Frozen Domain, which is also the correct Grievous Wounds target. Pillar of Ice being impassable terrain that can eat Skip 'n Slash was absent from both layers and is the single most punishing interaction in the lane.
